function: Transformer predicts RI, CQI and PMI of all RBs from BS and UE geolocation, replacing CSI feedback; MAC matching is not learned (p. 5, 6).
system: Downlink SU-MIMO OFDM, FD-RAN with 5 micro-cell BSs, single-polarization (6,1) panel, 4 UE antennas, 3.5 GHz (also 7 GHz), no RIS (p. 9, 10, 11).
method: Supervised multi-objective classification with a Transformer (1 encoder, 2 decoder layers, learnable per-RB queries), trained offline on historical CSI labels, retrained per scenario (p. 5, 9, 11).
data_channel: Vienna 5G system-level simulator, channel model 3GPP TR 25.890, urban map; 50,000 random training and 5,000 test geolocations (p. 9, 10).
test_conditions: Same map, unseen random geolocations; geolocation-error sweep; Shopping Mall map and 7 GHz band tested after retraining on 50,000 new geolocations (p. 10, 11).
baselines: Non-learned: 5G feedback-based CLSM, Round-Robin and Best-CQI schedulers; learned: independent Transformer (ablation), FCNN, independent FCNN for CSI prediction (p. 9, 12, 13).
metrics: Normalized MAE of RI, CQI, PMI prediction; per-user throughput; network spectral efficiency; Jain's fairness; per-RB throughput CDF; matching convergence (p. 10, 12, 13, 14).
complexity: Table I: 43.98 M parameters, 167.8 MB, 3.19 GFLOPs, 5.32e-5 s per BS-UE pair over 100 RBs; matching algorithm O(W^2) (p. 9).
openness: none; p. 9 mentions 'the codes' without any link.
q1_support: p. 10: "3GPP TR 25.890"; Table II lists it as the channel model of the Vienna 5G system-level simulator, which generates both the training and the test data.
q2_support: p. 11: "We therefore retrain all compared models in this new environment"; the paper says it does not claim zero-shot generalization, and the new map and 7 GHz band are retrained, not adapted from the first model.
q3_support: p. 9: "we add two additional CSI prediction baselines, namely Fully Connected Neural Networks (FCNN) and Independent FCNN" (normalized MAE); p. 12: "5G CLSM, i.e., a feedback-based 5G MIMO transmission method" (throughput).
q4_support: p. 9: "CaFTRA requires only 44 million parameters and 168 MB of memory"; Table I on the same page also gives FLOPs and computational time.
q5_support: p. 10: "a historical CSI dataset with 50,000 randomly sampled user geolocations is first generated in Vienna 5G system-level simulator"; the dataset is self-generated and no code or data link or DOI is given.
notes: Area 2: the learned model predicts CSI report parameters (RI, CQI, PMI) from geolocation and the main metric is normalized MAE of CSI prediction (p. 5, 10); borderline with link adaptation. q1 marked 1 for the reviewer to confirm: Table II names 3GPP TR 25.890, not TR 38.901 (p. 10). The independent Transformer is an ablation and not counted for q3; the FCNN baselines are. The Vienna simulator is public, but the generated dataset is not released.
